notes.title: COMPETITION! Trading cards, backgrounds, icons and emoticons ...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello friends! We need your help![/h1]

[h2]We want to release our Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, Badges and Emoticons, but in order to do this we need to overcome the barriers set by Steam: [u]The number of additions to the wishlist, the number of game launches, the number of purchases.[/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38479648/6ef4848362082c5cf2a97545b79c3e9d0340c949.png[/img]

[h3]That is why we will make a competition. Randomly, for those who leave a comment here and put Like, we will give the key to the game. The end of the competition is September 2.
Also, if you have any suggestions for new skins, write in the comments. Let's read the all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38479648/e273ff37dedcd913169e490cd95f9be4f2788d28.png[/img]

Tell all your friends about this game! Together we can get Doggo emoji and backgrounds!
Thanks you![/h3]

Best regards, 
Take Toad

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38479648/4278973a42bae7cf6f8059a3689192028f0452f7.png[/img]

notes.title: Greetings from the developers!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello friends![/h3]

For all questions about the game, write to us by mail - [u]vottakiepravilanahooi@gmail.com[/u]. We will be happy to help you.
[previewyoutube=HVlmnxaHh6o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's left for us:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Work on optimization. The game is ready, but it weighs too much and takes a long time to load. Now our main task is to fix this.
[*] Add coins while flying on a cyber bike.
[*] Add more effects.
[*] Add more sounds.
[*] Sleep ...
[/list]

The game will be released on September 1.

If you like our game, please [b]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38479648/1642dd0c6a1c42465358d6f0f3ab40da13711c60.png[/img]

[h2]If you have ideas for new skins for the game, write to us by mail - [u]vottakiepravilanahooi@gmail.com[/u]. We will be happy to consider all your applications. Thank you![/h2]
